_comment: Curated UKRAINIAN-WEB action sites (thesis novelty claim: no open CUA corpus — Mind2Web, WebArena, WebVoyager, GAIA, WebLINX — has meaningful .ua coverage). Same schema as public_sites_actions_logingated.json / _indie.json, loadable by public_capture.load_sites and capture_logingated.load_sites unchanged. Every `instruction` is a terse Ukrainian-language user GOAL, never a step-by-step procedure — the agent works out the route. `probe` records what each host actually returned on the date checked: `headless` is the verdict from the Playwright Chromium the autonomous lane uses, `headed` (where recorded) from a real browser window like the human-provisioning lane. Sites whose headless verdict is `blocked` carry skip_capture so the default sweep passes them over; name them explicitly (--sites <name>) to route them through the human-provisioned lane, which cleared 15 of the 19 (the other 4 were not retested headed). Banks and financial institutions are excluded by the project's safety spec. `provisioning` is a curated difficulty hint, not a probed fact — only reachability and WAF posture were probed.
